decisions.reason: Although the firm publicly launched this standalone web service, it is a relatively generic add-on with limited strategic centrality, so escalation of commitment is weaker and management is fairly likely to discontinue it.
This niche database likely required domain-specific investment and supports a specialized market position, so management would tend to justify staying with it despite uncertain traction.
Because this service appears close to the firm's consultancy and analytics capabilities, prior investment and strategic fit make management inclined to continue rather than abandon it quickly.
The tariff database shows enough visible commitment and sector-specific development effort that management would still be somewhat more likely to persist than to withdraw it.
Custom web services are highly consistent with the core business of a medium German software and consultancy firm, so management would strongly favor retaining this offering.
A postal code lookup service is comparatively easy to replace and less central to the firm's announced direction, so the commitment forces are weaker and discontinuation is more likely.
